q.line: They didn't know they'd been disabled
stanza: The dead soldiers lined up on the table
They didn't know they'd been disabled
Felt a wave, a rush of blood
You won't be happy 'til the bottle's broken
You're out swimming in the flood
You kept back, you kept unspoken

partner.line: The dead soldiers lined up on the table

stanza: Do you want to sit at my table?
And fortune finds me fit and able

partner.line: Do you want to sit at my table?
